title: GAZENG's "Solace" is that real R&B
htmlContent:
GAZENG's "Solace" is that real R&B that keeps the culture moving. He truly puts on a clinic to show what real R&B is all about, with everything hitting on all cylinders to make a masterpiece. His presence is felt all over this track displaying supreme confidence on the mic with no hesitation.
